problem.title: L-LO KITTI Odom seq 05 full (2761 frames): ground-height-map vertical mode
problem.question: Does the opt-in ground-height-map vertical estimate (pitch_mode 3, not in the paper) change full-sequence accuracy with the fixed seq07_tuned horizontal setting?

variants.label: Seq 07 tuned (fresh reference)
variants.intent: Fixed Table 6 setting (cluster_cell 0.25, ground_tolerance 0.15, max_range 80), rerun on the same binary as the candidate.
variants.command: build/evaluation/pcd_dogfooding dogfooding_results/kitti_seq_05_full experiments/reference_data/kitti_seq_05_full_gt.csv --methods l_lo --summary-json experiments/results/runs/l_lo_kitti_seq_05_full_ground_map_matrix/seq07_tuned/summary.json --l-lo-set cluster_cell=0.25 --l-lo-set ground_tolerance=0.15 --l-lo-set max_range=80
variants.note: Landmark convex-hull overlap odometry, frame-to-frame (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose). mean_matches=39.913 frames_below_3_matches=0/2760
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Close enough to the current default to keep as a live alternative.

variants.label: Seq 07 tuned + ground-height-map vertical (not in the paper)
variants.intent: Same horizontal setting; height, pitch and roll against a 30-frame world ground-height map (pitch_mode 3). Opt-in, default off.
variants.command: build/evaluation/pcd_dogfooding dogfooding_results/kitti_seq_05_full experiments/reference_data/kitti_seq_05_full_gt.csv --methods l_lo --summary-json experiments/results/runs/l_lo_kitti_seq_05_full_ground_map_matrix/seq07_tuned_ground_map/summary.json --l-lo-set cluster_cell=0.25 --l-lo-set ground_tolerance=0.15 --l-lo-set max_range=80 --l-lo-set pitch_mode=3
variants.note: Landmark convex-hull overlap odometry, frame-to-frame (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose). mean_matches=39.913 frames_below_3_matches=0/2760
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.
